verdict.rationale: Sill is a personal screen-streaming and remote-control app that shows a Mac window or desktop on an iPhone or iPad, so user-scheduled recurring jobs or workflows fall outside its product category. The daily update check, nightly builds and Launch at Login are the app's own housekeeping, release process or startup behavior, not schedulable user workflows, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
